problem: Leaves curling upward and turning yellow, plants stunted, many whiteflies
action: Removed infected plants, set yellow sticky traps, sprayed neem oil 5 ml/L
outcome: Spread stopped within 2 weeks, 80% of remaining plants healthy

problem: Leaf curl and yellowing with whitefly
outcome: No improvement, disease kept spreading (virus, not fungus)

problem: Leaf curl, stunted growth, whiteflies on leaf underside
action: Yellow sticky traps and neem oil, removed worst plants

problem: Dark water-soaked patches on leaves, white mold underside, fruit rot
action: Sprayed metalaxyl + mancozeb, stopped overhead irrigation

problem: Late blight patches spreading on leaves and fruit
outcome: Lost most of the crop in 10 days

problem: Concentric brown rings on lower leaves, leaves drying
action: Removed lower leaves, sprayed mancozeb, mulched

problem: Rosette flowers, damaged bolls, larvae inside bolls
action: Pheromone traps, destroyed damaged bolls, timely picking

outcome: More leaves, no effect on boll damage

problem: Leaves curling and turning reddish, aphids and jassids on leaves
Whiteflies and sticky honeydew on leaves, sooty mold
action: Yellow sticky traps, neem oil, removed weeds nearby
outcome: Whitefly population fell by about half

problem: Reddening of leaves, poor boll set
Spindle-shaped grey spots on leaves, neck rot on panicles
action: Sprayed tricyclazole at first symptoms, reduced nitrogen

problem: Circular patches of dried plants (hopper burn), insects at base
action: Drained field, avoided excess nitrogen, wider spacing next season

problem: Dead hearts in young plants, whitish panicles later
Yellowing of lower leaves, stunted tillers
action: Top-dressed urea and drained stagnant water
outcome: Recovered green colour in a week
